questions.question: How are leakages detected and localized using the reconstructor and the predictor?
questions.reference: A reconstructor estimates the actual pressures from current measurements and a predictor estimates leak-free pressures from previous measurements. Leakages are detected and localized by analyzing the discrepancies (residuals) between the two outputs.
